newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end higher on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end higher on selective buying.

text.p: Delhi shares closed higher on Thursday as domestic and foreign investors made selective purchases and speculators covered short positions ahead of Friday's fortnightly settlement, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 3.09 points higher at 881.77.

"Today's recovery seems to be temporary and mainly attributed to late buying by overseas investors and speculators. The fate of the market would depend on the outcome of today's crucial meeting," said S.C. Juneja of brokers Jaico Credit and Co.
A select panel of alliance leaders began meeting on Thursday to discuss the regional Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party's proposal to quit the United Front government.
Reliance Industries closed 0.80 rupee higher at 350.10.
State Bank of India quoted 6.55 rupees up at 337.75.
Nestle India was up 2.65 rupees to 282.70.
